# GeoNames attribution

Contains geographical information from **GeoNames**, [geonames.org](https://www.geonames.org/), licensed under [Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/) ([legal code](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode)). Source and licence information: [GeoNames about](https://www.geonames.org/about.html) and [download readme](https://download.geonames.org/export/dump/readme.txt).

Yorungez downloaded `cities500.zip`, `admin1CodesASCII.txt` and `TR.zip`; selected city points and additional Turkish ADM2 reference points, joined region names, retained native/ASCII names, coordinates, country/population/feature and ID, sorted/reformatted as JSON and compressed. These are modifications; no endorsement by GeoNames is implied. Original-file and derived-content fingerprints/retrieval record: [manifest](../../data/places/manifest.json); [scope and limitations](../../data/places/README.md).

Attribution is also visible in the location search UI. These point data do not establish administrative boundaries, addresses or GPS accuracy.
